subtitle: On-device AI assistant
promotional_text: Chat with AI on your phone. No Wi-Fi required. Free forever. On-device model runs locally, your conversations never leave your device.
description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: responses are generated on your device using a supported system model or a downloaded open-weight model. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
On supported devices, a system model is ready without a download. Other devices download a local model once before offline chat. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud is in public alpha: sign in for cloud chat and web search on the free tier, with image generation on Pro and above. There are no in-app purchases in this version.

PRIVACY FIRST
We do not claim full DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Our itemised India DPDP notice is published at https://agiworkforce.com/privacy/india, and the obligations we have not met, verifiable parental consent, notice in Eighth Schedule languages, and India data residency among them, are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/trust. AI output is labelled as AI-generated, and first run names the on-device model and any cloud provider. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. Signing in to AGI Cloud uses your account email (and name, if provided by your sign-in method) to create your account. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy

age_rating.note: App Store Connect calculated 9+ from the content questionnaire on 2026-09-26; its 13+ age-rating override was selected to align with the Cloud age gate. Regional ratings may differ.

data_linked_to_you.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud (public alpha). Email is required to create the account; name is collected if provided by the sign-in method.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends and any photos or files attached to them are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.

Only during live voice mode in an AGI Cloud chat: the microphone is streamed to AGI Cloud for the session and the transcript is saved to that chat. Dictation and the turn-based voice companion transcribe on the device and upload no audio.

Only after sign-in: the account identifier on every authenticated cloud request, and an app-generated device UUID registered with the push token so notifications reach the right install. No advertising identifier is collected.

Only in AGI Cloud and only after the user allows product analytics in Settings, Privacy (off by default; a workspace administrator can also turn it off): event names such as a stopped or regenerated response, recorded against the account. No message, file or file name is included. Local Mode sends none.

privacy_nutrition_labels.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud (public alpha, open to any signed-in user) collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends; product interaction events are added only when the user allows product analytics. Conversation content is processed by the model-provider subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors on AGI's behalf; it is never used to track the user across other companies' apps or websites.

pricing.in_app_purchase_note: The iOS binary includes native StoreKit purchase code. New purchases require an enabled server catalog, registered App Store product IDs, and account upgrade access; checked-in backend templates leave MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED off. Billing still shows Restore purchases while new sales are off, and configured products remain eligible for receipt verification. Before offering purchases in a submitted build, register the products, change in_app_purchases to true, replace the description's no-purchases claim, provide App Review a signed-in account and access code, and test purchase, restore, renewal, and refund in StoreKit sandbox. This repository cannot prove current live deployment or App Store Connect state. The binary links expo-iap; the server owner is mobile-iap-catalog.ts. When the deployment flag is off, the catalog reason is "Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment." On iOS without registered products it is "App Store products have not been registered for this build." On Android without registered products it is "Google Play products have not been registered for this build." The Billing screen can show "Loading native purchases" and "Workspace administration" before or alongside its store status.
pricing.guideline_3_1_1_residual_risk: The iOS app has external account and support links described in REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md. Billing includes View invoices for paid accounts, Workspace administration for Team and Enterprise, a subscription-owner management action that opens the original seller or store, Contact Sales for Team or Enterprise, and Help with a purchase. The change-email alert and workspace administration controls open the AGI Workforce website. Sign-in, signup, Terms confirmation, privacy settings, password recovery and desktop pairing link to their legal, account or safety pages. Usage is displayed natively from the authenticated usage API and has no web link. New native purchases remain disabled pending StoreKit products and live sandbox verification. The Stripe billing portal is unreachable while FEATURES.billing is false; the Android Add a member browser action is not used on iOS. External website links pass through the HTTPS host allowlist in lib/safeOpenURL.ts. These links and App Review purchase policy need a current signed-build review before submission.

export_compliance.info_plist_key: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false, declared in ios.infoPlist in apps/mobile/app.config.js
export_compliance.basis: All cryptography is Apple OS-provided: TLS via URLSession, Keychain via expo-secure-store, SecRandomCopyBytes via expo-crypto, and SQLCipher compiled with -DSQLCIPHER_CRYPTO_CC (ExpoSQLite.podspec) so its codec calls Apple CommonCrypto. No proprietary or bundled third-party cipher ships in apps/mobile. Flip to true and obtain an export-compliance code if that ever changes.

availability.territories: All App Store territories excluding: Mainland China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Crimea
